intro: SBI Clerk (Junior Associate) runs in two online stages: a 100-question, 100-mark Prelims of one hour and a 190-question, 200-mark Mains of 2 hours 40 minutes, each with timed sections and a quarter-mark penalty for every wrong answer. There is no interview.
note: The official advertisement (CRPD/CR/2026-27/17, dated 11 August 2026, 9,124 vacancies) names only the sections and their question and mark splits; SBI does not itemise a topic-wise syllabus in the notification. Detailed exam information is issued in the 'Acquaint Yourself' booklet along with the call letter. The topic lists below reflect the conventional scope of the SBI Clerk papers mapped to this site's subjects; check the official notice and the booklet for the final word.

sections.name: English Language
sections.tip: The Prelims has a 20-minute timer on each of the three sections, so you cannot carry time over from one section to the next.

sections.name: General/Financial Awareness
topics: Current affairs of roughly the last six months
sections.tip: The advertisement names this section without itemising topics; recent SBI papers lean heavily on banking, finance and economy news.

sections.name: General English
topics: Vocabulary: synonyms, antonyms, idioms in context

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
topics: Data interpretation: tables, bar charts, line graphs, pie charts, caselets, missing data
Time and work, pipes and cisterns
sections.tip: One-fourth of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for every wrong answer in both stages.

sections.name: Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude
topics: Puzzles and seating arrangement (linear, circular, floor-based, scheduling, tabular)
Statement and assumption, statement and conclusion, course of action
Flowchart and logic-based computer reasoning questions
sections.tip: In the Mains this is one combined section worth 60 marks, with multi-variable puzzles set at a higher difficulty than the Prelims.

sections.name: Computer Aptitude
topics: Cyber security and internet safety basics
sections.tip: There is no separate computer paper: computer aptitude is tested inside the combined Mains Reasoning & Computer Aptitude section, and the Prelims has no computer questions.
